Workflows.title: Search and Discover Photos
Workflows.goal: Verify users can access the Unsplash landing page to begin content discovery.
Workflows.feature_area: Visual Content Discovery and Stock Photography
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click the search input field at the top
3. Type 'nature' and press Enter
4. Alternatively, click on a category like 'Wallpapers' or 'Nature' in the top navigation bar
agent_activity_summary: The agent initiated the test by navigating to the Unsplash homepage. However, the execution terminated immediately after the initial page load, failing to perform the search for 'nature' or interact with any category navigation as required by the user scenario.
agent_activity_error: The agent stopped execution after Step 1 without attempting the search or category selection. While the execution flow status is marked as 'COMPLETED', it only reflects the completion of the navigation step, not the user scenario. No recovery was attempted for the missing steps.
agent_activity_outcome: The goal was not achieved. The agent reached the landing page but did not search for content or browse categories.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate potential bot detection triggers that may have halted the agent. Implement stealth automation techniques or manual intervention to bypass WAF/bot mitigation on Unsplash. Ensure the agent is configured to continue to the search input after the page load event.

Workflows.title: Image Interaction & Download
Workflows.goal: Verify users can access the photo grid for image selection.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click on any photo in the grid to open the detail view
3. Click the chevron (arrow) next to the 'Download free' button
4. Select 'Medium' from the dropdown menu
5. Verify the download starts and a 'Say thanks' pop-up appears
agent_activity_summary: The agent initiated the test by navigating to Unsplash.com but failed to progress into the photo detail view. Instead of interacting with the photo grid as required by the scenario, the agent entered a loop of clicking 'Go home' links and writing to a local file. After a failed attempt to restart the workflow by navigating to a search engine, the agent terminated the session, citing a hard blocker. None of the functional requirements—selecting a photo, choosing a download size, or verifying the 'Say thanks' pop-up—were attempted.
agent_activity_error: At Step 2 and 3, the agent deviated from the goal by clicking 'Go home' repeatedly instead of selecting a photo. At Step 5, the agent attempted an illogical recovery by searching for 'Unsplash' on DuckDuckGo. The agent finally encountered an unrecoverable state at Step 6 and terminated the execution without completing the task.
agent_activity_outcome: The test failed. The agent did not select a photo or initiate a download, failing to meet any of the core objectives of the user scenario.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Address the bot detection issues mentioned in the scenario notes, as they likely prevented the agent from interacting with the photo grid. Implement more specific selectors for the image gallery and ensure the agent is not distracted by administrative links like 'Go home'.

Workflows.title: View Photo Metadata and EXIF Data
Workflows.goal: Verify users can access technical EXIF data for images.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to a photo detail page (e.g., https://unsplash.com/photos/Dwu85P9SOIk)
2. Click the 'Info' (i) icon below the image
3. Review the 'Views', 'Downloads', and 'Exif' data (Camera, Aperture, etc.)
agent_activity_summary: The agent failed to initiate any actions for the requested scenario. The execution flow indicates a 'NO_STEPS' status, meaning the automation did not navigate to the target URL or interact with any elements on the Unsplash website.
agent_activity_error: Critical Error: The execution terminated immediately with a 'NO_STEPS' status. No steps were attempted, and therefore no recovery actions were possible. This suggests a failure in the agent's initialization or environment setup.
agent_activity_outcome: The goal was not achieved. The agent did not perform any of the steps required to check the technical details or engagement stats of the photo.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the automation runner's logs to determine why the agent failed to start. Ensure that the environment is correctly configured and that the agent has connectivity to the target URL (https://unsplash.com/photos/Dwu85P9SOIk).

Workflows.title: Submit Advertising Inquiry
Workflows.goal: Contact the Unsplash team for advertising or product placement. Note: Direct form blocked; alternative email flow identified.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/advertise
2. Click 'Get in touch'
3. If the form is blocked, navigate to https://help.unsplash.com
4. Search for 'partnership' and locate the contact email: brands@unsplash.com

Workflows.title: Access API Documentation
Workflows.goal: Navigate to the developer documentation to learn about API integration.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'View the documentation' button
3. Verify redirection to https://unsplash.com/documentation

Workflows.title: Request Research Dataset Access
Workflows.goal: Verify that users can reach the dataset request form from the Unsplash Data page.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/data
2. Scroll down to the 'Full' dataset section
3. Click the 'Request access' button
4. Complete the external Typeform with research details
agent_activity_summary: The agent attempted to submit a request for the Unsplash research dataset. It successfully navigated to the Unsplash data page, scrolled to the 'Full' dataset section, and identified the 'Request access' button. Upon clicking the button, the agent was redirected to an external Typeform URL. However, the Typeform page failed to load any content, resulting in a blank page. The agent performed extensive recovery attempts, including page reloads, direct URL navigation, and restarting the workflow from the homepage, but the Typeform remained inaccessible. The task was terminated after confirming a persistent hard blocker on the external form.
agent_activity_error: The primary issue occurred at Step 4, where the external Typeform (unsplash.typeform.com) loaded as a blank page. The agent attempted to recover by: 1) Waiting for the page to load (Step 5, 9), 2) Navigating back to the source page to retry the click (Steps 6, 11, 26), 3) Navigating directly to the Typeform URL to bypass redirects (Step 10), and 4) Searching for alternative contact methods (Step 25). None of these actions resolved the issue, as the Typeform consistently failed to render content for the automated agent.
agent_activity_outcome: The goal was not achieved. While the agent successfully reached the final step of the Unsplash-hosted workflow, the external Typeform required to complete the request was non-functional/blocked.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the external Typeform URL for potential bot detection or rendering issues. Manual intervention is required to complete the form, or the automation script may need to be updated with specific headers/cookies if the site is blocking headless browsers.
test_steps: Load the Unsplash dataset information page
Scroll down the page to bring the 'Request access' link into view.
Click the link to initiate the dataset request process.
The agent reached the Typeform URL but the page content failed to load.
